name: facemorph-me
description: FaceMorph monorepo root (fm-fy2.4): npm workspaces for the app and the four packages, strict TypeScript and the Oxc gates. build:next writes deploy-next/ (docs/dev/build-next.md).

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/stylegan-js -w packages/browser-model-manager -w packages/cloudflare-model-host --if-present && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm test --workspaces --if-present && node --test scripts/build/scaffold.test.mjs scripts/hosting/hosting.test.mjs tools/ort-qualify/qualify.test.mjs scripts/delivery/runbook.test.mjs scripts/ci/fetch-artifact.test.ts scripts/ci/path-filters.test.ts scripts/ci/intercept/intercept.test.ts && python3 scripts/ci/intercept/test_intercept.py && python3 scripts/ci/lease/test_lease_run.py
